title: Pain and Gain
subtitle: Tearing free from his shackles, he soars.

items.text: Study, Yamen

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Urgh!
The door swings back toward him, and he instinctively pushes it aside. Ink droplets fly across his face.
He sidesteps, revealing the Longevity Sword strapped to his back.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You do indeed work wonders, Commander. My lost sword has shown up at your door before I even asked for it.
The elegant woman in Daoist robes withdraws her brush mockingly, looking over to the commander.
He offers no response; instead, his eyes linger on the blade Chéng Héguāng now holds half-drawn.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Héguāng, take a seat.
He gestures toward a chair in the room. Chéng Héguāng doesn't budge, his hand trembling over the grip of the sword.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Pardon the intrusion, Master Rén. This is Chéng, that subordinate I've mentioned, a promising young man. He has proven to be of great use.
Chéng Héguāng makes it clear he will not offer a greeting. Lì Huìfēng decides not to insist before introducing him to the woman as if his arrival had been nothing more than a social visit.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Héguāng, this is Master Rén, the head of the School of Mei and a respected friend of Lord Lù. I have told her of your hardships, and she has expressed her sympathies.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Well met, Chief Constable Chéng. Your commander speaks highly of you. I hope you do not bear me any ill will. I understand some blame my school for your unfortunate fire.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You have suffered a great deal of troubles. I can only imagine how far your star would rise if it weren't for your unfortunate parentage.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: If fate has led us to meet this day, it must have its reasons. I cannot do much, but I may offer some aid to your career.
She removes a token from her waist and tosses it before the young constable.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: A personal gift from the venerable Lord Lù. His influence carries quite far, I'm sure you know. I wonder how he might look upon the constable that returned my sword to me.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: With our recommendation, a promotion would certainly follow.
Chéng Héguāng maintains his grip on the blade, not sparing the token on the ground even the courtesy of a glance.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You-You've been conspiring all along. All that talk of evidence, hmph, it was just an attempt to stall me.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You've been in their pocket from the start!

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Héguāng.
His commander interjects, attempting to douse the young constable's fiery accusations.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Pick up the token. Is this not what you've always wanted? To redeem your family name?

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Take it. Your long-cherished wish can come true.
His voice drips out at a measured pace, as always.
Chéng Héguāng stares in disbelief. The blade's shadow on the wall wavers.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Lì Huìfēng! Have you lost your senses?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Do you hear yourself? If she takes this sword, she will bring calamity upon us all!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Not only do you act as an agent of evil, allowing her to harm your people, but you even dare to profit from their suffering! You—

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Hahaha ...
The Daoist woman begins to laugh, as if their exchange had only been an amusing story.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: "Agent of evil"? "Profit from their suffering"? Have you looked at yourself, Chief Chéng?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Haven't you been arresting Yao day and night for the sake of your own glory? Are you not the very reason they sought refuge at my door?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: That is a perversion of the truth! Hah! I should've seen it before—the Reversion Bell. How else could our town have come by a Daoist relic? The parade itself was your doing!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: For all of the Yao you imprisoned and interrogated, you still had no knowledge of our designs, did you?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Those poor, pitiful Yao, only wanting another day to live, crushed beneath the chief's boots, in his hunger for power.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Lies! They were arrested for deceiving the people, not for my benefit!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Hah! Deceiving the people! And what lie was it that drove them to beg for the Method of Longevity?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Were they deceived, or did they only accuse me out of spite after being turned away? Some "investigation"!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: As you strode through that prison, did it ever cross your mind that the truth may be the very opposite?

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: We only want a little more time in this world, Chief Chéng. Why must you stand in our way?

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: Only a few borrowed days! We never hurt anyone!

items.speaker: Bird
items.text: I've done nothing wrong! Release me! Every moment is precious!
Cold sweat drips over Chéng Héguāng's temples. He realizes with some pain that this woman speaks the truth.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Hmph. You needn't trouble yourself, Chief Chéng. In fact, I should thank you.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Were it not for your diligence, I'd have never gathered so much Qi in such a short time.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Hmph. Whether Huanzhou is saved or meets its ruin this night, much of the credit shall be yours.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You—
He glares, eyes raging with fury, but the Daoist Master no longer seems willing to entertain him as she drifts to Lì Huìfēng's side.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You humans are odd indeed. Have you not spent your entire life attempting to cleanse yourself of your father's dishonor?

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Why shy away from your actions now, when they might finally be rewarded?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: That's not why I did it! I didn't—

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Héguāng.
Before he realizes it, Lì Huìfēng has already retrieved the token from the floor.
Chéng Héguāng sees it clearly for the first time. A symbol of power, inlaid with gold and silver.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Pick up the token, and put down the sword.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: You have heard too much; you can't stay here any longer. Take the token and go. Find a new life for yourself elsewhere.
He brushes away the dust and extends the token toward Chéng Héguāng.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Or have you forgotten the vow you made to me?

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: What is your want?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: My father brought shame not only upon himself, but upon those who placed their trust in him. I swear I will not make the same mistake.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It is said that a warrior is a warrior, and a bandit is a bandit. But I am not my father, and I will remove the stain on my family name!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Commander, all I ask is one chance!

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: *sigh* Chief Chéng, I pray you would not hold my words against me. They were spoken in the heat of the moment.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: *sneer* You are human, and we are Yao. Beings of different kinds are never of one mind. Our natures simply do not align.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: So your interests clash with ours. Why blame yourself for what was bound to happen?
Between truth and lies, their voices grow distant, then near, back and forth like a swinging pendulum.
Though the autumn wanes outside, inside the air feels thick and stifling.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: A warrior is a warrior, and a bandit is a bandit.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Beings of different kinds are never of one mind.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: So that's how it is. Hahaha, hahahaha.
He's been backed into the corner.
No escape remains.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Commander, for the last time—

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Are you aware that Huanzhou now lingers at the edge of destruction?
Under the lamplight, his mentor's expression remains unclear. But his voice holds steady and darkly calm.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Yes and no—

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Does it even matter?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hahahaha, fair point! A fair point!
All his rage, shock, and disappointment dissolve into a single bitter laugh.
In that instant, Chéng Héguāng's blade leaves its sheath as ink strikes toward his waist.
In a flash, several oil lamps are extinguished. The token shatters into worthless scrap under the ink's force.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I should have known.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: For years, I worked to prove myself to you, hoping my merits would prove the strength of my character. I was so fixated on my goal that I failed to see the truth.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Now I see it clearly. Seeking favor from people like you only led me deeper into dishonor.
He shakes his head ruefully, mourning years of wasted effort.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I never cared about promotions or power. I only ever wanted to do what was right.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If I picked up that token, I would be betraying all that I believe in.
He tears his Chief Constable's token from his waist and throws it to Lì Huìfēng's feet.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Commander, you claim that it doesn't matter what you know. You think that I should be a soldier and follow what you say.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But I see now, I am a bandit, and I always will be!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I want no place among your kind!
In the flickering lamplight, Lì Huìfēng's blade flashes forward before his eyes.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Your father was once my friend. After what happened, I took it upon myself to aid you through your difficulties.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: But it seems you're too stubborn to be helped.
The two men meet in a furious clash of blades and incantations, reducing the room around them to shambles.
But at the height of their deadlock, Master Rén intervenes, suddenly striking Chéng Héguāng with her palm, forcing him back several steps.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: You hopeless fool! Surrender the sword at once!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I gave my word to protect it.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I've made many mistakes. I will not make another.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: If you want the sword, you'll have to kill me first!
The Daoist flicks her sleeves dramatically as her shadow on the wall transforms like a serpent shedding its skin.
Her gentle facade shatters, falling away like a cascade of ash.
Master Rén draws her iron brush and closes the distance in mere strides.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Ugh! Can't hold out much longer.
Dazed by her assault, he nearly misses the slip of red paper drifting past him.

items.speaker: Master Ren
items.text: Eyes forward. There's no escape now!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Ugh!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Chéng!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Take the sword!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: My thanks!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I hope I'm not too late!
